renderer: headless Chromium with software WebGL; not a native-device FPS benchmark

before.triangle_measurement: Reconstructed from all 19 baseline tiles using the unchanged extrusion geometry; postprocessing render counters are not scene triangle totals.

limits: Capture elapsed time includes browser startup, tile loading, automation and screenshot. It is not frame time. The renderer streams near the camera target; these images do not show every packaged tile.
